label: Market Close
headline: S&P +0.3%, Nasdaq +1.1%, SOX +4.2%, Dow -0.5%, 2y 4.51%, Dec hike ~80%, S&P week -2.7%
stance: Chips were bought back, the Dow and staples sold, and the 2y gave back Thursday's rally. Fourth straight weekly loss for the S&P; CPI Tuesday is the next test.

scorecard.call: Morning: the bounce starts in chips; payrolls decides whether the 2y rally holds.
scorecard.actual: Right on chips: SOX +4.2% at the close. The 2y rally is gone: 4.51% at the close, +5bp on the day.

scorecard.call: Midday: a close above Thursday's close on heavy volume is the bar.
scorecard.actual: Cleared on price: S&P +0.3% to 7,377, Nasdaq +1.1% at the close. Dow -0.5%. Volume not verified.

scorecard.call: Midday: does Nasdaq hold Thursday's low into the last 30 minutes.
scorecard.actual: Held. Nasdaq closed +1.1%, above Thursday's close; tech and communication services led at 4:00.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: December hike ~80% priced by the close, from 67% Thursday. Payrolls +165K plus +84K of revisions did it; hourly earnings +0.4% m/m.
Musalem Friday: excess inflation is coming from energy shocks and the AI buildout. One more payrolls report lands before the December meeting.
Oil flat Friday after the week's drop. Trump called Qatar's emir Friday on ending the war; IRGC says two more tankers struck mines in Hormuz.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: SOX +4.2% Friday after Thursday's -12.2%. Tech and communication services led; staples and financials lagged at the close.
Week: S&P -2.7%, Nasdaq -3.4%, Dow -0.9%. Fourth straight weekly loss for the S&P and Nasdaq, the worst S&P week since April 2025.
Asia took Thursday's hit Friday: Kospi -6.0%, Hang Seng -1.3%, ChiNext -4.0%. Stoxx 50 -1.0%.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: HY OAS Friday at its widest since the April 2025 tariff week; the lowest-rated tier near its widest since 2020.
Single-name AI CDS eased ~8% Friday from Thursday's record. Large-cap AI issuers' CDS stay low in absolute terms after a month of widening.
Five AI bond deals, $67bn, since Oct 29; hyperscaler issuance $296bn this year. Heavy supply is doing part of the widening.

items.head: Vistra +10% at 1:43 PM on a Q3 beat
items.body: Net income and revenue rose y/y, both above estimates. Oil service index +2.1% and the energy ETF +0.6% at the same time.

items.head: CoreWeave 5y CDS ~1,155bp Friday, from 1,289 Thursday
items.body: 2032 bond yield above 16%. Stock down more than 50% in a month. Reports Tuesday; funding costs are the call's question.

watch.head: Hormuz over the weekend
watch.body: Trump has said he will decide soon on resuming strikes. Iran's nuclear proposal via Qatar is under US review. Oil reopens Sunday evening.

watch.head: Monday 10:00: wholesale inventories; no tier-1 data
watch.body: First session after the S&P's worst week since April 2025. Does Friday's chip bid hold without a data catalyst.

watch.head: CPI Tuesday Nov 10, 8:30
watch.body: First inflation print at ~80% December odds. A hot core print reopens January, priced ~20% Thursday.

watch.head: Tuesday after the close: the neocloud report
watch.body: Funding costs and contract durations are the questions. Credit watches it more closely than equities do.
